name: In Heather's Wake
source:
On Halloween night, an antique jester doll awakens after years of waiting dormant in storage. Although his environment is new and unfamiliar, he would know his friend anywhere— and right now, it looks like she needs some serious cheering up. Follow Duskie on his quest to uncover what truly happened while he was asleep.

A visual chat sim visual novel that provides a heartfelt and somewhat nostalgic experience for players who enjoyed Halloween in the early 2000s.

[From [url=https://shellbrunchstudios.itch.io/in-heathers-wake]itch.io[/url]]
